description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

uses.name: Myr Welder
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with two or more charge counters on it
